title: 가입과 로그인
text: 계정을 신청하고 로그인하는 방법, 비밀번호와 기기를 관리하는 방법을 설명합니다.

title: 가입과 로그인
heading: 계정 신청
text:
1. 로그인 화면에서 **회원가입** 탭을 선택합니다.
2. 이름, 이메일, 비밀번호를 입력한 뒤 **가입 요청**을 누릅니다. 비밀번호는 10자 이상이어야 하며 숫자와 기호를 포함해야 합니다. 화면에 가입 가능한 주소가 안내되어 있으면 해당 도메인의 이메일만 신청할 수 있습니다.
3. 관리자가 지정한 가입 방식에 따라 다음 절차가 달라집니다.

| 가입 방식 | 신청 직후 |
|---|---|
| 승인 후 사용 | 승인 대기 화면이 표시됩니다. 15초 간격으로 상태를 확인하며, 승인되면 자동으로 홈 화면으로 이동합니다. |
| 바로 사용 | 대기 없이 바로 사용할 수 있습니다. |

**가입 요청**을 눌렀을 때 "지금은 회원가입을 받지 않습니다"라는 안내가 나오면 관리자에게 계정 발급을 요청하십시오. 이메일 인증이 설정된 환경에서는 확인 메일이 발송되며, 수신되지 않으면 1분 후 재발송할 수 있습니다.

title: 가입과 로그인
heading: 로그인
text:
이메일과 비밀번호로 로그인합니다. **비밀번호를 다섯 번 연속 잘못 입력하면 15분 동안 로그인이 차단됩니다.** 차단 중에는 올바른 비밀번호를 입력해도 로그인되지 않으므로 15분 후 다시 시도하십시오.

정지된 계정은 로그인 대신 안내 화면이 표시됩니다. 이 경우 관리자에게 문의하십시오.

title: 가입과 로그인
heading: 비밀번호 재설정
text: 로그인 화면에 **비밀번호를 잊으셨나요?** 링크가 있으면 재설정 메일을 받을 수 있습니다. 메일의 링크는 30분간 유효하며 한 번만 사용할 수 있습니다. 새 비밀번호를 설정하면 즉시 로그인되고 **다른 기기의 로그인은 모두 해제됩니다.** 링크가 표시되지 않는다면 메일 서버가 설정되지 않은 환경이므로 관리자에게 초기화를 요청하십시오.

title: 가입과 로그인
heading: 비밀번호 변경과 기기 관리
text:
- 비밀번호 변경: 계정 메뉴 → **설정** → **프로필**. 변경 시 다른 기기의 로그인이 해제됩니다.
- 로그인된 기기 목록과 접속 기록: **설정** → **보안**. 자세한 내용은 설정을 참고하십시오.

title: 가입과 로그인
heading: 자동 로그아웃
text: 관리자가 유휴 시간을 설정한 환경에서는 해당 시간 동안 조작이 없으면 자동으로 로그아웃됩니다. 다시 접속하면 로그인 화면에 자동 로그아웃되었다는 안내가 표시됩니다.

title: 가입과 로그인
heading: 화면 언어
text: 오른쪽 위 **EN** 버튼으로 화면 언어를 전환합니다. 답변 언어는 화면 언어와 무관하게 **질문한 언어**를 따릅니다.

title: 결과물
text: 보고서, 슬라이드, 차트, 코드, 웹 페이지, 이미지 등 대화에서 생성된 결과물은 사이드바의 **결과물** 화면에 모입니다.

title: 결과물
heading: 결과물 패널
text:
- 결과물이 생성되면 패널이 자동으로 열립니다. 닫은 경우 대화 화면 오른쪽 위의 **보고서 열기**, **덱 열기** 등의 버튼으로 다시 엽니다.
- 공통 기능으로 버전과 수정 시각 표시, 복사, 다운로드, 너비 조절(더블클릭 시 초기화), 좁게·넓게·문서만 보기, 닫기를 제공합니다. 화면이 좁으면 대화 위에 겹쳐서 표시됩니다.
- 코드와 웹 페이지는 **미리보기**와 **소스** 탭, 확대·축소를 지원합니다. 웹 페이지는 격리된 창에서 실행되므로 값을 저장하는 기능은 동작하지 않습니다.
- 챗에서도 "표로 정리해 문서로 만들어 주세요", "이 데이터로 차트를 그려 주세요"와 같이 요청하면 결과물이 패널에 생성됩니다.

title: 결과물
heading: 내보내기 형식
text:
| 종류 | 형식 |
|---|---|
| 보고서 | PDF, Word(DOCX), 한글(HWPX), 마크다운 원문, 인쇄 |
| 슬라이드 | PowerPoint(PPTX), PDF, 텍스트(노트 포함) |
| 템플릿을 적용한 문서 | PDF, DOCX/PPTX, HWPX, HTML, 텍스트 |

PDF는 테마를 그대로 반영하고, DOCX와 PPTX는 편집 가능한 구조를 우선하므로 템플릿의 시각적 요소가 일부 달라질 수 있습니다.

title: 결과물
heading: 갤러리
text: 사이드바의 **결과물**에서 전체 목록을 확인합니다. 종류별 탭(전체, 코드, HTML, 보고서, 슬라이드, 차트, 이미지, 오디오, 동영상)과 제목 검색을 제공합니다. 카드를 선택하면 갤러리 안에서 패널로 열리고, 생성된 대화로 이동하려면 카드의 **원본 작업 열기**를 사용합니다. 갤러리에서 삭제하면 버전 기록까지 함께 삭제되지만 대화는 유지됩니다.

title: 결과물 편집기
text: 보고서와 슬라이드는 오른쪽 패널에서 직접 편집할 수 있습니다. 상단 리본의 탭에 따라 기능이 구분됩니다.

title: 결과물 편집기
heading: 보고서 패널
text:
리본은 **홈 · 편집 · 삽입 · 레이아웃 · 검토 · 보기 · 파일** 로 구성됩니다.

### 홈

**웹뷰**와 **페이지뷰**(A4 실제 쪽)를 전환하고, 문서 테마(편집형, 매거진형, 미니멀), 강조색, **템플릿**을 바꿉니다. 웹뷰에서는 **원문**으로 마크다운 전체를 편집할 수 있습니다.

### 편집

- **문서 수정**: 페이지에서 직접 편집합니다. 굵게, 기울임, 밑줄, 취소선, 글자색, 형광펜, 줄간격, 목록과 들여쓰기, 인용, 표 삽입 및 행·열 조작과 병합, 쪽 나누기, 출처 인용 삽입, 찾기 및 바꾸기, 실행 취소를 지원합니다.
- **원문**: 마크다운 전체를 편집합니다. `Ctrl+Enter` 로 저장합니다.
- 절 제목 옆 메뉴에서 앞·뒤 절 추가, 복제, 위·아래 이동, 삭제, **이 절만 다시 쓰기**, 검토를 수행합니다. 마지막 한 절은 삭제할 수 없으며, **이 절만 다시 쓰기**에 지시문을 입력하면 해당 절만 다시 작성합니다.
- 본문의 문장을 선택하면 **이 부분 고치기**가 표시됩니다. 선택한 문장을 인용해 수정을 요청합니다.

### 삽입

**그림 넣기**에서 삽입할 절, 그림 생성 방식(새로 생성 또는 기존 그림 선택), 캡션을 지정합니다. 삽입한 그림은 파일에 포함되므로 인쇄와 공유에도 함께 전달됩니다. 이미지 기능이 비활성 상태이면 새로 생성할 수는 없습니다.

### 레이아웃

**페이지 설정**(머리말, 꼬리말, 쪽 번호)을 제공합니다.

### 보기

**목차** 창을 열고 닫으며, 목차 창에서 진행 상황과 단어 수를 확인합니다. 넓게 보기, 문서만 보기, 패널 닫기는 리본이 아니라 패널 오른쪽 위의 버튼에서 선택합니다.

### 파일

PDF, Word(DOCX), 한글(HWPX), 마크다운 원문, 인쇄로 내보냅니다.

title: 결과물 편집기
heading: 슬라이드 패널
text:
리본은 **홈 · 편집 · 삽입 · 검토 · 보기 · 슬라이드 쇼 · 파일** 로 구성됩니다.

### 홈

슬라이드 테마를 편집형, 미니멀, 포스터형, 분할형, 다크, 강철, 따뜻한, 파스텔, 숲, 학술, 흑백 중에서 선택하고, 강조색을 변경하며, **이 장 다시 만들기**를 실행합니다.

### 편집

- 슬라이드의 문자를 클릭해 직접 수정합니다. 굵게, 기울임, 크기, 색상을 지정할 수 있습니다.
- 텍스트 상자 일괄 편집에서는 첫 줄이 제목, 각 줄이 항목이 되며 `|` 로 표의 행을 구분합니다.
- 발표 노트, 표 데이터 편집(행·열 추가·이동·삭제), 차트 편집(막대·꺾은선, 단위, 계열)을 제공합니다.
- 그림 도구에서 이미지를 업로드하고(PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, 5MB 이하) 표시 방식, 크기, 좌우 배치를 지정합니다.
- 내용이 넘칠 때 자동 맞춤, 장 나누기, 레이아웃 변경, 글자 크기 조정, 실행 취소를 지원합니다. `Ctrl+S` 로 저장합니다.
- 장 메뉴에서 앞·뒤 추가, 복제, 이동, 삭제, 레이아웃, 글자 크기를 설정합니다. 여러 장을 선택해 강조색과 글자 크기를 일괄 변경하거나 서식을 초기화할 수 있습니다.

### 삽입

그림 넣기와 바꾸기, 자동 생성된 도식을 이미지 모델이 그린 그림으로 교체하는 기능을 제공합니다.

### 보기와 슬라이드 쇼

장 목록 창과 장 이동을 제공합니다. 발표 모드는 슬라이드 작성을 참고하십시오.

### 파일

PowerPoint(PPTX), PDF, 텍스트(노트 포함)로 내보내며 대본 복사를 지원합니다.

title: 결과물 편집기
heading: 검토
text:
| 기능 | 내용 |
|---|---|
| 자동 검사 | 모델을 호출하지 않고 문서를 검사합니다. 반드시 고쳐야 할 항목(P0: 빈 내용, 작성되지 않은 블록, 자리표시자, 렌더되지 않은 마크다운, 한국어 문장에 섞인 중국어 한자, 근거 없는 수치, 산술 오류)은 **고칠 곳 n**, 살펴볼 항목(P1: 군더더기 표현, 이모지로 시작하는 문장, 반복된 줄, 한 장에 줄이 너무 많음, 두 행을 넘는 줄)까지 합친 수는 **볼 곳 n**으로 표시합니다. **고치기** 또는 **모두 고치기**로 수정합니다. 슬라이드는 **잘림 위험 n장**을 별도로 안내합니다. |
| 검토 받기 | 모델이 문서를 한 번 읽고 10점 만점의 점수와 최대 6개의 지적 사항을 제시합니다. 점수는 참고용이며 내보내기를 제한하지 않습니다. |
| 팩트체크 | 절 또는 장의 주장을 근거와 대조합니다. 근거 주소가 없는 판정은 **확인 필요**로 낮춥니다. 의견과 정의는 판정 대상에서 제외합니다. |
| 근거 패널 (보고서) | 출처 목록, 인용 점검, 인용 형식(APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE), 자료 직접 추가, 미사용 자료 삭제, 조사 기록(검색어, 채택, 제외)을 제공합니다. |
| 검토 메모 (슬라이드) | 장별 메모를 추가하고 해결 또는 재개 처리합니다. 미해결 메모가 있으면 배지로 표시됩니다. |
| 버전 기록 | 아래를 참고하십시오. |

title: 결과물 편집기
heading: 버전 관리와 충돌 처리
text:
저장, 다시 쓰기, 복원이 실행될 때마다 스냅샷이 저장됩니다. 리본 **검토 → 버전 기록**에서 이전 판의 내용을 확인하고 추가·삭제·수정 내역을 비교한 뒤 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

다른 창에서 같은 문서를 수정한 경우 **최신본 불러오기** 또는 **내 편집 내용 복사** 중에서 선택하도록 안내합니다.

title: 결과물 편집기
heading: 템플릿 적용 문서의 편집 제한
text: 템플릿을 적용한 보고서와 슬라이드는 블록 단위 다시 쓰기만 지원하며 마크다운 원문 편집은 제공하지 않습니다. 내보내기 형식은 PDF, DOCX/PPTX, HWPX, HTML, 텍스트입니다.

title: 이미지와 오디오/동영상
text: 관리자가 활성화한 경우에만 홈 화면에 **이미지**와 **오디오/동영상** 탭이 표시됩니다. 대부분 외부 생성 서비스를 사용하므로 크레딧이 소모되며, 전송 전에 예상 크레딧이 안내됩니다. 파일 첨부는 지원하지 않습니다.

title: 이미지와 오디오/동영상
heading: 이미지
text:
입력창 아래의 옵션으로 지정합니다.

| 칩 | 선택지 |
|---|---|
| 비율 | 16:9 · 9:16 · 4:3 · 1:1 (모델이 지원하는 것만) |
| 스타일 | 자동 · 구조도 · 흐름도 · 개념도 · 인포그래픽 · 차트 · 사진 · 일러스트 · 미니멀 · 3D 렌더 · 수채화 · 없음 |
| 글자 | 자동 · 한국어 · 영어 · 없음 |
| 장수 | 1 · 2 · 4 |

결과 카드에서 확대 보기, 내려받기, **다시 만들기**, **프롬프트 고치기**, **보낸 프롬프트 보기**(실제 전송된 최종 문장)를 제공합니다. 차트는 텍스트 모델이 코드로 그리며 **그린 코드 보기** 와 **이 코드로 다시 그리기** 를 사용할 수 있습니다. 비율 지정을 지원하지 않는 모델을 선택하면 정사각형으로 생성된다는 안내가 표시됩니다.

**구조도 · 흐름도 · 개념도** 는 이미지 모델을 쓰지 않습니다. 텍스트 모델이 설명을 흐름도로 쓰고, 서버가 보고서·슬라이드의 도식과 같은 도형으로 그려 그림으로 남깁니다. 단계가 너무 많거나 흐름도로 옮길 수 없는 내용이면 "이 도식은 그릴 수 없습니다. 단계를 줄여 다시 시도해 주세요." 라는 안내가 표시되고 그림은 만들어지지 않습니다.

이미지·오디오·동영상에는 템플릿이 없습니다. 입력창 **+** 메뉴의 템플릿 고르기는 보고서와 슬라이드에만 있습니다. 프로젝트 테마의 색상과 이미지 스타일은 요청문에 함께 반영됩니다.

title: 이미지와 오디오/동영상
heading: 오디오
text: 내레이션(목소리 선택) 또는 음악을 15초, 30초, 60초, 120초 길이로 생성합니다. 결과는 재생기와 내려받기로 제공하며 내레이션은 대본이 함께 표시됩니다. 오디오는 생성 1회 단위로 과금됩니다.

title: 이미지와 오디오/동영상
heading: 동영상
text: 비율, 해상도(720p 또는 1080p), 소리 유무, 길이(4~10초)를 지정합니다. 영상 생성은 시간이 오래 걸리므로 카드에 진행률이 표시되며, 화면을 새로 고치거나 다른 기기에서 접속해도 완료된 결과를 확인할 수 있습니다. 생성을 취소할 수 있으며 크레딧은 완료된 경우에만 차감됩니다. 모델이 가격을 산정하지 않는 조합을 선택하면 "이 모델은 이 조합을 만들지 않습니다"라는 안내가 표시되고 전송이 차단됩니다. 테마는 오디오와 동영상에 적용되지 않습니다.

title: 보고서 작성
text: 홈에서 **보고서**를 선택하고 작성할 보고서의 주제를 입력합니다. 근거 자료가 있으면 입력창의 **+** → **첨부**로 올리십시오. 자료를 첨부하면 수치를 추정하지 않고 자료에 있는 값으로 채웁니다. 검색 서버가 연결된 환경에서는 작성 전에 웹을 검색해 출처를 인용합니다.

title: 보고서 작성
heading: 1단계: 구성 확인
text:
문서를 바로 작성하지 않고 **구성**을 먼저 제시합니다. 작성에 필요한 정보가 부족하면 구성보다 앞서 **시작하기 전에** 카드가 나타나 확인 질문을 표시합니다. 답변하거나 **있는 자료로 진행**을 선택하면 구성 단계로 넘어갑니다.

- 절 제목을 수정하고 순서를 변경하거나 절을 추가·삭제할 수 있습니다. 고친 뒤에는 **처음 제안으로**로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.
- 구성 카드는 내용만 다룹니다. 문서 테마는 작성 후 리본의 **편집 → 테마**에서 고릅니다.
- **이대로 생성** 또는 수정한 경우 **고친 대로 생성**을 누르면 작성이 시작됩니다.
- 카드 아래 입력창에 문장을 입력하면 그 내용을 조건으로 구성을 다시 제안합니다. 승인은 버튼으로만 가능합니다.
- 도식이나 그림이 필요한 주제이면 이어서 **그림을 넣을까요?** 카드가 표시됩니다. 장수와 예상 크레딧이 함께 안내되며, 도식은 텍스트 모델이 생성하므로 이미지 크레딧이 발생하지 않습니다.

title: 보고서 작성
heading: 2단계: 작성
text: 절 단위로 순서대로 작성하며, 첫 절이 완성되는 즉시 오른쪽 패널에 표시합니다. 작성에 실패한 절은 실패로 표시하고 나머지 절의 작성을 계속합니다.

title: 보고서 작성
heading: 3단계: 수정
text:
두 가지 방법을 제공합니다.

- **요청으로 수정**: 문서 하단 입력창에 "2번 절을 절반으로 줄여 주세요", "절을 하나 추가해 주세요"와 같이 입력합니다. 요청으로 수정
- **직접 편집**: 패널의 리본에서 문장을 수정하고, 절 순서를 바꾸고, 그림을 넣고, 검토를 받습니다. 결과물 편집기

title: 보고서 작성
heading: 요청문에 지정할 수 있는 항목
text:
| 입력 예시 | 반영 내용 |
|---|---|
| "4개 절로" | 절 수를 지정합니다. 3~12절 범위입니다. |
| "검토 보고서", "주간 보고", "회의록", "장애 보고" | 문서 종류에 맞는 구성을 적용합니다. 판단을 요구하는 문서에만 요약과 권고 절이 포함됩니다. |
| **+** → 템플릿 고르기에서 템플릿 선택 | 해당 템플릿의 구성 규칙과 조판을 적용합니다. |

title: 보고서 작성
heading: 내보내기
text: 리본의 **파일 → 내보내기**에서 PDF, Word(DOCX), 한글(HWPX), 마크다운 원문, 인쇄를 선택합니다. 근거가 확인되지 않은 항목이 있으면 내보내기 전에 안내합니다. PDF는 테마를 그대로 반영하고, DOCX는 편집하기 좋은 구조를 우선합니다.

title: 요청으로 수정
text:
작성이 끝난 보고서와 슬라이드 하단의 입력창에 수정할 내용을 입력합니다. 요청 내용을 분석해 수정할 부분과 방식을 자동으로 판단합니다. 문장 단위 수정이나 장 순서 변경은 결과물 편집기를 사용하는 편이 빠릅니다.

| 요청 예시 | 처리 방식 |
|---|---|
| "2번 절을 절반으로 줄여 주세요", "결론에 일정 표를 추가해 주세요" | 해당 부분만 다시 작성합니다. 나머지는 유지됩니다. |
| "전체적으로 더 간결하게", "말투를 존댓말로" | 모든 부분을 다시 작성합니다. |
| "20장으로 늘려 주세요", "3장 추가", "2번과 3번을 합쳐 주세요", "순서를 바꿔 주세요" | 구성을 다시 제안하고 승인을 받은 뒤 작성합니다. 유지할 부분은 기존 제목을 그대로 사용합니다. |
| "새로 써 주세요", "처음부터 다시", "다른 주제로" | 기존 문서를 유지한 채 새로 작성합니다. |

수정이 완료되면 "N곳을 고쳤습니다"라는 안내와 함께 패널에 즉시 반영됩니다. 수정할 때마다 이전 본문이 버전으로 저장됩니다.

부분 수정 시에도 최초 요청과 첨부 자료를 다시 참조합니다. 새로운 자료를 반영하려면 자료를 첨부한 상태에서 수정을 요청하십시오.

title: 공유
text: 대화 화면 오른쪽 위의 **공유** 버튼으로 링크를 생성합니다.

title: 공유
heading: 링크 생성
text:
1. 공개 범위를 선택합니다.

   | 범위 | 열람 가능한 대상 |
   |---|---|
   | 계정이 있는 사람 | 이 서비스에 로그인한 모든 사용자입니다. 부서나 팀 단위의 제한은 적용되지 않습니다. |
   | 링크가 있는 사람 | 링크를 아는 모든 사람이며 계정이 없어도 열람할 수 있습니다. |

2. **링크 만들기**를 누르고 **복사**합니다.

생성 후에는 상태가 **계정 필요** 또는 **계정 없이 열림**으로 표시됩니다.

title: 공유
heading: 공유되는 범위
text:
- 해당 대화와 그 대화에서 생성된 결과물이 공개됩니다. 결과물이 먼저 표시되고 대화가 이어집니다. 일부 종류는 공유 화면에서 아직 지원하지 않는다고 안내합니다.
- **프로젝트 파일과 메모리는 공유되지 않습니다.** 대화에 첨부한 파일은 답변에 인용된 범위까지 노출됩니다.
- **공유 이후에 이어지는 대화도 링크에 계속 반영됩니다.** 특정 시점까지만 공개하려면 링크를 철회하고 새로 생성하십시오.

title: 공유
heading: 열람 기록과 철회
text: 같은 창에서 열람자(이름과 이메일 또는 "계정 없는 방문자"), 브라우저, 지역, 열람 횟수를 확인할 수 있습니다. 한 시간 이내의 반복 열람은 한 번으로 집계합니다. **링크 철회**를 실행하면 해당 주소는 즉시 열리지 않습니다. 대화를 삭제한 경우에도 링크가 차단됩니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
text: 홈에서 **슬라이드**를 선택하고 발표 주제와 대상을 입력합니다. 진행 절차는 보고서와 동일합니다. 확인 질문, **구성 확인**, **그림을 넣을까요?** 카드, 장 단위 작성 순으로 진행됩니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 구성 확인 항목
text:
- 장 제목과 순서
- **어떻게 사용할 자료인가요?**: 발표하면서 설명 또는 자료만 전달

테마는 구성 카드에서 고르지 않습니다. 작성 후 패널에서 편집형, 미니멀, 포스터형, 분할형, 다크, 강철, 따뜻한, 파스텔, 숲, 학술, 흑백 중에서 선택합니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 장 수 지정
text:
| 입력 예시 | 반영 내용 |
|---|---|
| "6장", "20장짜리" | 지정한 장 수로 작성합니다. 최대 50장입니다. |
| "20분 발표" | 2분당 1장을 기준으로 최소 장 수를 산출합니다. 20분이면 최소 10장입니다. |
| 지정하지 않음 | 주제에 맞춰 5~12장으로 작성합니다. |

6장을 초과하면 두 번째 장에 목차가 삽입됩니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 장 유형
text: 모델이 내용에 맞는 유형을 선택합니다. 표지, 목차, 항목 나열, 표(비교), 지표(핵심 수치), 차트(자료에 수치가 있는 경우), 도식(흐름과 구조), 마무리를 사용합니다. "비교는 표로", "흐름도를 포함해"와 같이 요청문에 지정할 수 있습니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 테마 변경
text: 패널의 **편집 › 테마** 탭에서 테마와 강조색을 변경하고 **이 장 다시 만들기**를 실행할 수 있습니다. 프로젝트에 테마가 연결되어 있으면 해당 색상과 서체를 따릅니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 발표 모드
text: 리본의 **슬라이드 쇼**에서 전체 화면으로 전환합니다. `←` `→` 로 장을 이동하고 `Esc` 로 종료합니다. 발표 시간 타이머와 `N` 키로 표시하는 발표 노트, 장 목록을 제공합니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 내보내기
text: **파일 → 내보내기**에서 PowerPoint(PPTX), PDF(발표용), 텍스트(노트 포함)를 선택합니다. 내용이 잘릴 우려가 있는 장, 근거 확인이 필요한 장, 미해결 검토 메모가 있으면 내보내기 전에 안내합니다. **대본 복사**로 슬라이드 본문과 발표 노트를 한 번에 복사할 수 있습니다. 어두운 인상은 PPTX에만 적용되며 PDF는 밝은 배경으로 출력됩니다.

title: 슬라이드 작성
heading: 수정
text: "2번 장을 더 간결하게"와 같이 요청하면 해당 장만 다시 작성합니다. "20장으로 늘려 주세요", "사례 장을 추가해 주세요"처럼 구성을 바꾸는 요청은 구성을 다시 제안한 뒤 승인을 받습니다. 자세한 내용은 요청으로 수정을 참고하십시오. 문장을 직접 고치거나 장 순서를 바꾸려면 결과물 편집기를 사용하십시오.

title: Administrator guide
text:
When you sign in with an administrator account, a **Manage** item appears in the account menu. The first account to sign up holds administrator rights.

| Screen | What it does |
|---|---|
| Users · Credits | Approve and reject sign-ups, suspend, edit details, monthly credits, allowed models, key management |
| Usage | Usage by period, by model, and by user, CSV, storage space |
| Security · Audit | The **Policy** tab (personal data protection, safe model, blocked topics, idle sign-out, retention period) and the **Audit log** tab |
| System | The **Proxy · Routing · Features · Branding · Mail · Sign-up** tabs |

title: Administrator guide
heading: Order of initial setup
text:
1. **System → Proxy**: Enter the model gateway address and master key, then check the connection. Until this is set, no models are available to use.
2. **System → Features**: Enable the features you will use and test the connection to each feature integration address (web search, document import, code execution, deep research, speech transcription, material search).
3. **System → Sign-up**: Set the sign-up method and the allowed email domains, and enable email verification if you have a mail server.
4. **System → Mail**: Set up SMTP if you need password reset and verification mail.
5. **System → Branding**: Set the service name, logo, and contact address.
6. **Security · Audit → Policy**: Designate the strict-local safe model and decide how personal data is protected.
7. **System → Routing**: Decide whether to use Auto mode.
8. **Users · Credits**: Process the accounts waiting for approval.

For the details of each item, see Users and credits, Policy and routing, and System settings.

title: Policy and routing
text: This screen sets the level of personal data protection, the audit record, and automatic model switching (Auto).

title: Policy and routing
heading: Policy settings
text:
| Item | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Personal data masking | Always masks national ID numbers, card numbers, phone numbers, and email addresses in every request, and stores them masked. The original cannot be sent |
| Personal data protection for external models | In Chat, asks the user to choose when personal data is detected for a model that may switch to an external provider |
| strict-local safe model | The model that "Switch to a safe local model" sends to. Only chat models the gateway declares as strict-local are candidates. **If you leave it empty**, users see a notice that there is no safe model |
| Allow sending the original outside | Whether users may ignore the warning and send. Not possible while the masking policy is on |
| Intent-based filter + topics to block | Refuses the request without using credits and records it in the audit log |
| Automatic sign-out when idle | In minutes. 0 turns it off |
| Conversation retention period | In days. Once the period is up, the conversation body is deleted (applied retroactively, with the number deleted shown). Records and usage remain |

If the server cannot read the policy, it blocks sending in Chat, reports, and slide decks for safety (503).

In an environment where every model runs on organization servers, **Personal data protection for external models** has little effect. An organization model that is not declared strict-local is treated as a model that may switch to an external provider, so a warning appears. Declare strict-local on the gateway and designate a safe model, or disable the protection feature.

title: Policy and routing
heading: Audit log
text: Time, account, action, target, and access location. The log covers sign-ins, failures, approvals, suspensions, permission changes, setting changes, key issuance, discards, password resets, token reuse detection, and more. Search by account, action, or IP. It cannot be edited or deleted from the screen.

title: Policy and routing
heading: Auto routing
text:
- **Auto · Cost saving** — an on/off switch, the difficulty classification model (free strict-local only), and up to 3 saving models in priority order. A saving model is used only when its output price is lower than the quality model the user chose, its data boundary is no wider, and its context length is sufficient. In an environment where every model is free, there is nothing to save, so it does not run.
- **Auto · Quality first** — an on/off switch and up to 3 upgrade models.
- **Structuring stage model** — The model that sets the outline for a report or slide deck. If you leave it empty, it is the same as the writing model.

The default model per screen is not an administrator setting. It sits under **each user's Settings → Preferences**. Administrators only restrict the allowed models per user.

title: System settings
text: The **System** screen in the Manage menu is made up of seven tabs.

title: System settings
heading: Proxy
text: The model gateway (LiteLLM) address and master key (stored encrypted, never shown again), **Connection test** (confirms n models), **Refresh model list**, and revert to the environment variable values. If models are listed as hidden for lack of price information, enter the model prices in the gateway settings.

title: System settings
heading: Routing
text: The routing settings are described in Policy and routing.

title: System settings
heading: Features
text:
- **Features to use**: Turn reports, slide decks, images, and audio/video on and off. Chat is always on. Disabling one removes it from the menu, and the server refuses new conversations for it as well. Images and video work in practice only if the gateway has those models. If you enable them without a model, the user screen shows a notice that generation is not possible.
- **Feature integration**: One feature server address, or an address per feature (web search · document import · code execution · deep research · speech transcription · material search). **Connection test** individually and for all of them. Setting a speech transcription address enables dictation and reading audio and video files. With a material search (indexing) address, agent material and conversation attachments are searched by vector (word search only without it).

The safe search level and blocked domains for web search are set on the search server. For details, see the backend (KloudChat-LLM) documentation. By default, safe search is off.

title: System settings
heading: Branding
text: The service name, the contact address (used by the mail link on the waiting screen; the first administrator's address if left empty), and the logo (PNG, JPG, WebP, up to 2MB, no SVG, with revert to default). Changing the service name also changes the browser tab icon to the matching initials.

title: System settings
heading: Mail
text: The SMTP host, port, security, account, and sender address, the service address (for mail links, with **Use the current address**), and **Send a test**. Once it is set, a password reset link appears on the sign-in screen and you can turn on email verification.

title: System settings
heading: Sign-up
text:
- **Sign-up method**: Use after approval / Use immediately / Not accepted. The value chosen on this screen overrides the `SIGNUP_MODE` environment variable.
- **Email domains allowed to sign up**: Several, separated by commas. Subdomains have to be listed separately.
- **Email verification**: Not effective without a mail server.

title: System settings
heading: Connector catalogue
text: The MCP servers people can install from **Customize** › **Connectors**. **Add entry** takes a name, slug, transport (run a command over stdio, HTTP or SSE), the command or address, environment variables and surfaces. Write tool addresses as placeholders such as `${TOOLS_STT_URL}`. Pick a **variable that gets the gateway key** and `TOOLS_GATEWAY_KEY` is added only while that variable is the chosen tool's address (this is how YouTube transcription calls speech-to-text). Stored values are never shown again; type one only to replace it. Servers that run as a command can only be added here. Turn off **Show in the list** (목록에 보이기) and the entry leaves the members' list but can still be installed, and what is installed keeps working (the admin list marks it Hidden). Turn off **Enabled** and nobody can install it anew.

title: System settings
heading: Management items outside the System tab
text:
- The **Usage** screen: charts by period, by model, by screen, and by user, CSV export, and storage space (disk usage, orphan file cleanup, and automatic cleanup from the oldest when it fills up).
- **Theme**: An administrator can **provide a theme to every user** (shared, read only).
- **Store**: Agents and skills published by an administrator account carry an **Official** badge. Built-in skills hidden from the lists (kept only as parts) show to administrators only with **Show hidden** (숨김 포함).
- The trusted proxy range, the file size limit, and similar settings are configured through environment variables rather than the screen. See `docs/configuration.md` in the repository.

title: Users and credits
text: This is the **Users · Credits** screen in the Manage menu. The top of the screen summarizes the total number of users, the number waiting for approval, this month's usage and allocation, and the next refill date. Below it are tabs by status (All, Waiting for approval, Active, Suspended) and a search by name and email.

title: Users and credits
heading: Approving sign-ups
text: If the sign-up method is **Use after approval**, new accounts build up as waiting for approval and the account menu shows "N waiting for approval". Press **Approve** on a row to approve the account immediately with the default plan credits. The model gateway user and key are created at that point. Handle accounts you will not approve with **Reject**. An account that has not completed email verification shows a **Mail not verified** badge. Approving the account counts the verification as complete. Selecting several at once is not supported, so you have to approve each account individually.

title: Users and credits
heading: Management items per user
text:
| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| Credits | Change the monthly limit. The gateway budget is adjusted by the same amount |
| Model restriction | The models this account can use. Leave it empty for all of them. It applies to API keys too |
| Edit details | Name and email, **Reset password** (a random password; saving it signs out all of the user's sessions) |
| Key management | Reissue the gateway key (the existing key is discarded at once) or replace it. List and delete the API keys the user created |
| Suspend / Unsuspend | Reversible, and a record is kept |
| Delete | Deletes conversations, projects, results, memory, credit records, and the gateway key. You choose whether to delete the uploaded files and the generated image and video files from disk |

title: Users and credits
heading: Credit policy
text: The credits of an approved account reset to the allocation on the 1st of each month and do not carry over. In an environment that runs only free models, credits are not consumed, and the limit applies in practice only when external models or the image and video features are enabled.

title: Users and credits
heading: Cleaning up accounts
text: Delete accounts created for verification or load testing once you are done with them. If you do not delete them, they are counted in the usage totals as well.

title: API and coding tool integration
text: You can call the models your organization runs from your own code or from a coding tool. The account menu has two screens, **API integration** and **AI agent integration**.

title: API and coding tool integration
heading: API integration
text:
1. Issue a key under Settings → **API keys**.
2. Follow the examples shown on the screen. Examples are provided for the OpenAI SDK, streaming, the LiteLLM SDK (`openai/` prefix), curl, and embeddings.
3. For the model name, use **the id shown in the model list** exactly as it appears.

```bash
# Linux / macOS, OpenAI-compatible

```

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
$env:OPENAI_BASE_URL = "https:///llm/v1"
$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = ""
```

Usage is added to your account limit and is counted separately under **By API key** on the usage screen. Any allowed-model restriction set on the account applies to the key in the same way.

title: API and coding tool integration
heading: AI agent integration
text:
This screen explains how to connect coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to organization models. Issue a key, choose a model, then copy the commands from the tab for your operating system (Linux · macOS · Windows).

| Tool | Environment variables |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https:///llm`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` |
| Codex · OpenAI-compatible | `OPENAI_BASE_URL=https:///llm/v1`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_MODEL` |

Note that the Anthropic-format address has no `/v1` while the OpenAI-format address includes it.

`export` and `$env:` apply only to the current terminal session. To keep them, add them to `~/.bashrc` or `~/.zshrc`. If another project uses a separate OpenAI key, use separate terminals so that the values do not conflict.

title: API and coding tool integration
heading: Key management
text:
- The key value is shown only once, when it is issued. Issue a new key if you lose it.
- Discard keys you no longer use under Settings → API keys.
- Do not type a key into the conversation box or into a document.

title: Agents and skills
text: An agent is an assistant with a role, instructions, tools, and material already configured. You make your own for work you do often, such as English conversation practice, meeting minutes, or paper review, or import one a colleague has published.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Starting a conversation with an agent
text:
**+** → **Agents** in the composer and **Run** in the agent list both start a new conversation with that agent.

- The first screen of the conversation shows the agent's **How to use** text and its **opening prompts**, up to six of them. Select an opening prompt to send it as it is.
- An agent conversation uses the model, tools, and material set on the agent. When material is registered, the model searches it with the **Find in files** tool. Not all of the material is sent with every request.
- Within the same project, other conversations reference the conclusions that the agent left through **Shared notes**.

The built-in agents are **Bullet-style briefing** (개조식 보고), **Compare and decide** (비교·결정), **Extract and tally** (자료 추출·집계) and **Minutes** (회의록: meetings, interviews, lectures). Bullet-style briefing and Minutes write straight into the institution's format and show the format check results when done. Extract and tally pulls set columns out of internal Excel and CSV files, totals them by item, and keeps a change log of the rows it removed or changed. **Official letter and draft** (공문·기안 초안) and **Presentation** (발표 자료) are published once they pass evaluation; until then only administrators see them. Copies taken under an earlier name (요약·정리, 기록 정리, 데이터 분석, 문서 작성) take the new name unless you renamed them. The cover letter and career history agent and the client proposal agent were retired: they no longer appear in any list or start new conversations, but conversations and results made with them still open and export.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Creating an agent
text:
**Customize** → **Agents** → **Add** → **Create an agent**. **Create agent** at the end of the composer's **+** → **Agents** list opens it too.

The form runs from top to bottom like this:

1. The **name**, the **one-line description** and the **instructions** (the role and rules the agent always follows). Instructions for one surface only go under a line `[채팅에서]` (chat), `[보고서에서]` (report) or `[슬라이드에서]` (slides); what comes before the first such line applies everywhere.
2. **How it works** (진행 과정): Answer directly · Start from a base process · Set it up yourself (advanced) (see "How it works" below).
3. **Extra work**: the bundle checkboxes (see "Bundles"). Set it up yourself has none; you build steps instead.
4. **Detailed settings — The process's calculations, checks and outline**: shown only for an agent that writes reports (see "Detailed settings and your own templates").
5. **Missing-information questions**: what to ask before writing when the material lacks it; up to four at a time while "Ask for missing information first" is on. A * marks a field you must fill.
6. Under **More settings**: **Output shape**, **Conversation start**, **Sources**, **Skills and tools**, **Advanced** and **Share** (see "Output shape and sources").

A new agent is saved only when you press **Create**. The instructions go with every conversation of that agent, so write only the role and rules it should always follow. An agent works when you open a conversation and ask; it never runs by itself on a schedule such as weekly, nor re-summarises its sources.

The enable toggle pauses an agent. Deleting it also deletes its sources, index and custom order; past conversations stay. The overview says how it works in one line, with the ticked bundles behind **Show details**.

title: Agents and skills
heading: How it works
text:
Pick one of three under **How it works** in the create-agent form.

- **Answer directly**: answers in the chat. It makes no file (DOCX, HWPX, PDF); to get a file, choose **Start from a base process** with a base that writes a document. When the name, description or instructions mention Word, DOCX or a file, a **Switch to “Bullet-style briefing (Bullet-style briefing (개조식))”** button appears. It switches to that base process and also ticks **Export a file when done** under **Finish** (HWPX, as a 개조식 document, or DOCX or PDF when the instructions name that format).
- **Start from a base process**: pick a built-in agent (Bullet-style briefing, Minutes, Compare and decide, …) from the **Base process** list and the agent follows the order it works in. Its steps appear as up to five plain lines, and the agent gets that built-in agent's questions, document format, template, checks and bundles. A base that writes a document still starts with file export off (see "Get a file" under Bundles).
- **Set it up yourself (advanced)**: pick questions, calculations, checks, reviews, other agents and exports one step at a time. It starts with one "This agent" step. Choose **Report (document)** or **Chat (answer)** under **What this agent makes**; an export step works only with Report (document). With Chat (answer) and an export step, the button under the warning switches that field to Report (document), and **Undo** on the notice switches it back. Presentation has no custom order.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Bundles
text:
A bundle groups a few things an agent does before and after writing. Each bundle is one checkbox under **Extra work** in the create-agent form; **Details** opens its items as checkboxes.

| Bundle | Items |
|---|---|
| Prepare before writing | Ask for missing information first · Work out dates ahead · Work out amounts and totals ahead |
| Review after writing | Check everything against the material (accept numbers only from tool output · check job titles and product names too) · Format checks · Fix what is off and check again |
| Finish | Strip stock phrases · Export a file when done (DOCX, PDF, HWPX or MD) |

- **Get a file**: with **Finish** ticked, a separate **Export a file when done** checkbox shows under it; tick it and pick the format beside it (HWPX for 공문-type documents, else DOCX). The base processes come with Finish ticked and export off. Export works only in a process that writes a document.
- On the report screen, date and amount calculations, format checks and fix-and-check-again always happen in report writing ("Always done"). The chat screen has no format checks and no export.
- Built-in agents use the same bundles: Minutes is Prepare before writing + Review after writing (including each action item's owner and deadline) + Finish (export off).
- **Your own bundles**: **Customize** → **Agents** → **Add** → **Create a bundle**, or **Save this order as a bundle** in a custom order. They appear under Extra work in all your agents; edit and share them from **Manage bundles**.
- Sharing works like skills (Only me · Everyone). A bundle or custom order that exports files, has another model review or calls another agent reaches others only once an administrator approves it under **Process review**; base processes and built-in bundles are shared at once.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Output shape and sources
text:
These sit under **More settings** in the create-agent form.

- **Output shape**: pick the **template** (the structure of a report or deck) and the **theme** (colours, typeface, writing style). **New template** under the template makes your own; **Manage themes** under the theme opens Settings › Themes. An agent started from a base process uses the base's template when the template is left empty ("The base's template"), and that template sets the document format. The **Document format** field shows only for a report-writing agent on Answer directly or Set it up yourself.
- **Conversation start**: **How to use** (shown on the conversation's first screen) and **Conversation starters** (one per line, up to six).
- **Sources**: files and web addresses the agent searches and cites (**Attach file**, **Add URL**). They are not sent whole with every conversation; the agent looks things up when needed. A URL stores the page as it was when added and does not follow later changes. Sources are not re-read or re-summarised on a schedule, and an agent never runs by itself at set times; it works when you open a conversation and ask.
- **Skills and tools**, **Advanced** (screens, first screen, model, variety, colour) and **Share**: **Only me** or **Everyone**, and when shared, **Let others take and edit it** or **Let others take it but keep the content private**.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Detailed settings and your own templates
text:
An agent that writes reports can turn on **Set for this agent** under **Detailed settings — The process's calculations, checks and outline** below the process and change what its template sets, starting from the template's values. Turned off, the template's (or document format's) settings apply as they are.

- **Calculate before writing**: built-in calculations such as dates, quote totals, staffing, total cost per option, must-haves and weighted scores, career periods; and the **date basis** (the material's date or the meeting day).
- **How it writes**: no web search, figures only when asked, a fixed outline.
- **Structure rules**: sections in order, required tables (columns), summary lines at the top, bullet style, page limit. Checked by code.
- **Review rules**: rules in your own words. After writing, a judge model shows the sentences that break them; nothing is rewritten.
- **Calculation checks**, **Judged checks**, **Format repairs**, **Fill in what is missing**: built-in checks and repair steps attached by name.
- **When the material disagrees**: left empty, the writing says which value it used and why.

Make your own document template with **New template** under **Output shape** › Template (or in the template picker). **Start from a built-in template** fills in all of its settings: the document format's head fields, numbering, head layout, bullet style and closing, the instructions, genre rule, checklist, missing-information questions, checks and detailed settings. An uploaded DOCX/HWPX form is read by the writing model as reference. The theme's colours and fonts draw it. Shared with **Everyone**, others can pick it; only its maker edits it. Your templates appear under **My templates** in the template picker.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Save as agent
text:
Keep a conversation that went well as an agent. **Save as agent** in the **⋯** menu of a result card, or of the report or slides panel, opens the create-agent screen filled in. Nothing is made until you press **Save**.

- The **instructions** start with "Settled in this conversation" (the reader, the length, what to always include …). Only your own messages are read, by the model the conversation used. A strict-local conversation is summarised only by its strict-local model and nothing leaves.
- The conversation's template, theme, skills, base process and bundles are filled in, and you choose whether to save the conversation's files as sources.
- A privately shared agent's instructions are never copied.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Workspace store
text:
**Explore** on **Customize** → **Agents** shows the agents that other users have published. An **Official** badge marks an item published by an administrator. Select **Import** to create a **copy** in your own list.

- A copy does not include the original author's knowledge files. Its process and bundles come along (a custom order still waiting for approval stays behind; the copy uses the base process).
- A copy of an agent published as "contents stay private" cannot be edited, and any change to the original applies to the copy as well.
- Other copies are managed independently, so a change to the original does not affect them.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Skills
text:
A skill is a working method that applies **to one request only**. Select up to three from **+** → **Skills** in the composer. They are cleared once you send. Installing a skill alone does not apply it. The built-in ones are listed under "Built-in skills" below.

- Use **Customize** → **Skills** to install a skill, stop using one, or build your own with a name, description, when to use it, steps, required tools, and visibility. A published skill is listed in the store, and other users import it as a copy.
- **Customize › Skills › Add › Upload skill** takes a SKILL.md (.md) or a .zip/.skill file containing one, several at a time. A .md file needs YAML front matter with `name` and `description`; .md and .txt files under `resources/` are appended to the body under 「참고 자료」 (References). Before anything is saved, each file shows a preview and its security-scan findings (blocked or warning). Scripts (.py, .sh, .js and the like) are never stored or run; they are left out. The text check is heuristic and will not catch every risk. **Upload as draft** saves the skill switched off.
- A skill's **⋯ → Export (SKILL.md)** downloads your skill as a SKILL.md file. Sharing is refused while a skill contains key- or token-like strings or invisible direction-control characters.
- A skill that requires tools is enabled only when all of these hold: you are on the Chat screen, the model supports tool calling, and that tool is connected. When a condition is not met, the reason is shown.
- When you set **Recommended skills** on a project, they appear first in the composer of that project.

title: Agents and skills
heading: Built-in skills
text:
The lists show seven: **Grounding check** (근거 대조), **Ask for missing information** (빠진 정보 묻기), **Calculation and unit check** (계산·단위 검증), **Date calculation** (날짜 계산), **Quote calculation** (견적 계산), **Excel cleanup** (엑셀 정리) and **PDF table → Excel** (PDF 표 → 엑셀).

- **Excel cleanup** strips title, blank, total and note rows and records what it changed on a change-log sheet. Rows whose values are all the same are not removed, only marked 「중복 의심」 (suspected duplicate); ask for them to be removed if you want that.
- **PDF table → Excel** reads only PDFs whose text can be selected (text PDFs). Scanned PDFs (images) cannot be read.
- The other skills (copy, market research, proofreading, stock-phrase stripping, character-count fitting and so on) are hidden from the lists, the store and the pickers. They are not deleted: they still run in bundles (such as Finish's stock-phrase stripping) and in earlier conversations, and the editors still let you pick them by name. Administrators see them with **Show hidden** (숨김 포함).

title: Conversation basics
text: On the home screen select **Chat**, enter a request, and press `Enter`. The answer is generated in real time. If you turn streaming off in settings, the answer appears all at once after it is complete.

title: Conversation basics
heading: Parts of an answer
text:
| Element | Details |
|---|---|
| Processing complete · N steps | The items referenced while the answer was generated. Expand it to see steps such as using attachments, carrying over attachments from earlier turns, applying personalization settings, referring to memory, searching the web, reading documents, running code, and searching files. Files that were truncated or could not be read also appear here. |
| Processing detail badge | Shows whether Auto switched the model, whether personal data was masked, and which model actually answered. On mobile it collapses to "n processing details". |
| Usage line | Shows the model name, input and output tokens, and credits. Free models are marked **Free**. You can hide this line in Settings → Preferences. |
| Sources | When a web search runs, numbers in the form `[1]` appear in the text and a source list appears below it. |

Copy and rating (👍 · 👎) buttons sit below the answer.

title: Conversation basics
heading: Stopping and resuming generation
text: While an answer is being generated, the send button changes to ■ **Stop**. If you stop, the content generated so far is saved and usage is recorded as an estimate. Generation continues on the server even if you close or refresh the browser tab, so you can return later and see the finished answer.

title: Conversation basics
heading: When generation fails
text: The answer area shows **Retry** and **Another model** buttons. **Another model** applies a different model to that request only.

title: Conversation basics
heading: Editing a sent message
text: In Chat, select **Edit message** (the pencil icon) next to a message you sent. The composer shows **Edit message · New conversation** and fills in the original text and attachments. When you send the edited text, the answer is generated in a **new conversation** that copies everything before that message. The original conversation stays as it was. Use **Cancel edit** or `Esc` to stop editing. You cannot edit while an answer is being generated.

title: Conversation basics
heading: Keeping conversation context
text: Within the same conversation, earlier questions, answers, and attached files stay available. Short follow-ups such as "So what happens next?" or "Explain that in more detail" work fine. When the topic changes, press **New chat** in the sidebar. Earlier context does not mix in, so the answer is more accurate.

title: Conversation basics
heading: Dictating a request
text:
Use the 🎤 button in the composer. It appears only where the administrator has connected a **speech transcription** server. There are two ways to use it.

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| 🎤 button or `Ctrl+Shift+M` | The recording is converted to text and placed in the composer. Edit it, then send. |
| Hold `Space` in an empty composer and speak | The request is sent the moment you release the key. |

Recordings are not stored. If there is no microphone or no permission, the message "Microphone is unavailable" appears.

title: Conversation basics
heading: Managing conversations
text:
- Use the `…` menu on a sidebar item to rename, pin, remove from a project, or delete. The title is generated automatically after the first answer.
- A new conversation with nothing sent is deleted automatically when you leave the screen.
- **Deleting a conversation also deletes the outputs and share links created in it.** Projects and memory are kept.
- To tidy up several conversations at once, use the account menu → **Conversation history**. Usage and conversation history

title: Conversation basics
heading: Adjusting answer length
text: KloudChat answers are designed to lead with the conclusion and to skip introductions, repeated explanation, and closing summaries. If you need a more detailed answer, add conditions such as "in detail" or "include examples" to your request. You can also describe the length you want under **Answer style** in Personalization.

title: Connectors
text: A connector is an external tool (an MCP server) that the model can call. Install one from the account menu → **Connectors**, and turn it on or off from **+** → **Connectors** in the composer. The on or off state applies to your **whole account**.

title: Connectors
heading: Built-in connectors
text:
| Connector | What it does |
|---|---|
| Time | Looks up the current time and date. Available in Chat, Reports, and Slides. |

**YouTube transcript** is hidden from the list; anyone who already installed it still sees it and it keeps working. **Deep research** is turned off in the catalogue, since it sends queries out to the web for minutes at a time; installed copies are not removed.

title: Connectors
heading: Adding a server directly
text: If you already use an MCP server, connect it with **Add server directly**. Enter the name, the transport (stdio, http, or sse), the run command or endpoint address, the environment variables, and the authentication method. Environment variables and credentials are not shown again after saving.

title: Connectors
heading: Tool permissions
text:
Set each tool on or off in the connector detail screen. A **write** tool that changes data asks for confirmation before it runs. Content returned by a connector is treated as external input, so any instructions inside it are not executed.

The more tools you enable, the less likely the model is to choose the right one, so enable only the tools you actually use.

title: Attaching files
text: Attach files from **+** → **Attach** in the composer, and the model answers from their content. You can attach several files at once, and you can drag and drop them or paste them in. The Images and Audio/Video screens do not offer attachments.

title: Attaching files
heading: Supported formats
text:
| Category | Formats | Conditions |
|---|---|---|
| Documents | PDF, Word (.docx), Hangul (.hwp, .hwpx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx) | The file must contain text. Scanned images are not recognized. |
| Text and code | .txt, .md, .csv, .tsv, .json, and most code files | Read as text. |
| Images | PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP | **4MB or smaller**. Sent only to **strict-local** models that support image recognition, marked 👁 in the list. |
| Audio and video | mp3, wav, mp4, and similar | **25MB or smaller**. Converted to text and read when the administrator has connected speech transcription. |

The maximum size for a single file is 200MB. Older Office formats (.doc, .ppt, .xls) are not supported. A file that could not be read appears as **Unread attachment** in the processing steps of the answer.

title: Attaching files
heading: How long an attachment is referenced
text:
An attached file stays available to later requests in the same conversation. It appears in the processing steps as **Attachment from an earlier turn**.

- When a file is too large to process at once, only the **parts relevant to your question** are selected and sent. Ask something such as "Tell me what Article 7 says" and the text around that article is sent.
- If the answer is not in the part that was sent, the model searches inside the file with the **Find in files** tool.
- The processing steps mark each attachment as used, truncated, or omitted.

The Reports and Slides screens do not carry over attachments from earlier requests, so attach the material for the document to that request directly. Files attached in another conversation are not referenced either. To use the same material in several conversations, register it in a project.

title: Attaching files
heading: Improving recognition accuracy
text:
- State exactly what you are looking for. "Summarize this file" is less accurate than "List only the remote work application steps from this file".
- Attach table-heavy material as Excel or CSV rather than PDF. It is read far more accurately that way.
- For an attached Hangul file (.hwpx), select **Open as document** on the file chip to convert it straight into an editable report. The conversion calls no model, so it uses no credits.

title: Attaching files
heading: Attaching images
text: Images are sent only to strict-local models that support image recognition. The personal data check reads text only, so images never go to a model that may send data outside the organization. If you select any other model, the file is attached but the model cannot see its content. Images from earlier requests are not sent again, so attach the image again to ask more about it.

title: Choosing a model
text: Select the model name to the right of the composer to open the list. When eight or more models are registered, a **Find a model** search box appears with it.

title: Choosing a model
heading: What the model list shows
text:
| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **strict-local** | The model is confirmed to run only on organization servers and to send nothing outside. Selecting it disables web search, page reading, and connectors. |
| **self-hosted · strict unverified** | The model runs on organization servers, but it is not confirmed that there is no external fallback path. |
| **May switch to an external provider** | The model normally runs on organization servers, but it may switch to an external service during an outage. |
| **External provider** | The model is supplied by an external service, so requests are sent outside the organization. |
| **Boundary unverified** | No information about the processing location is provided for this model. |
| Price | Input and output credits per 1,000 tokens, or **Free** |
| Context | How much can be processed at once |
| 👁 · 🔧 | Image recognition supported · Tool calling supported |

Depending on how the gateway registers models, one model name can appear as two entries that differ only in the data boundary label. Check the label before you select one.

title: Choosing a model
heading: Auto mode
text:
When the administrator enables it on the Chat screen, two modes appear at the top of the list. These modes apply to the conversation, not to a model.

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| Auto · Quality first | Only the requests judged complex switch to the higher model the administrator set. Everything else uses the model you selected. |
| Auto · Cost saving | Switches simple requests to a cheaper model. Everything else uses the model you selected. |

Auto does not apply to requests that use files, projects, agents, skills, or web search set to Always. Those requests use the model you selected. A badge above the composer then shows that Auto was not applied. Each answer also shows the reason for the decision and an estimate of the credits saved.

title: Choosing a model
heading: Scope of a model selection
text:
- **Selecting on the home screen** saves the model to your account as the **default model** for that screen, such as Chat, Reports, or Slides. It applies when you sign in from another device, and you can also change it in Settings → Preferences.
- **Selecting during a conversation** applies to that conversation only.
- An agent conversation uses the model set on the agent.
- When the administrator limits which models an account may use, only the allowed models appear.

title: Templates and themes
text:
These two features have similar names, but each has a different role and scope (they used to be called 양식 and 디자인). Work you do often belongs to agents. Neither is a Customize tab: you pick each where it is used.

| Feature | Role | Where to pick it | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Template** | The form of the output. The product includes report and slide templates. | **+** → **Pick a template** in the composer; **Output** › **Template** in the agent settings | That conversation (clear it with × on the chip), or the conversations that agent opens |
| **Theme** | A setting that bundles colors, typefaces, and writing style. | **Output** › **Theme** in the agent settings, **Edit › Theme** in the report or slides panel, the project settings | That agent's or project's outputs |

title: Templates and themes
heading: Templates
text:
A template defines the structure rules and the typesetting of reports and slides. Select one and the **What this template checks** list appears. You edit a document in a template by rewriting it one block at a time, and you can export it as PDF, DOCX/PPTX, HWPX, HTML, or text. Templates are built into the product, so you cannot create new ones. Images, audio and video have no templates. Retired templates (career history, client proposal) can no longer be picked, but documents made with them still open and export.

The built-in templates in the picker are six documents (internal draft 간이기안문, plan 추진 계획(안), result report 결과 보고서, bullet-style briefing 개조식 보고서, comparison report 비교·분석 보고서, minutes 회의록) and the **Briefing** deck. They write straight into the institution's format and show that format's check results when done. The other deck templates are hidden from the picker, not deleted: conversations and agents that used one keep writing and exporting with it.

title: Templates and themes
heading: Themes
text:
Manage them in **Settings** → **Themes** (also opened by **Manage themes** in the agent settings). Themes other people shared appear under **Shared themes** on the same tab.

- Set the name, the accent color, the body color, the secondary color, the typeface (sans-serif or serif), the writing style rules, the image style, and the rules to apply alongside them.
- **Import from a document** extracts a draft from an existing hwpx, docx, or pdf file, or from a web address. It calls the model once, and you can review the content before saving.
- The writing style applies to conversations, reports, and slides. Colors and typefaces apply to slides and report covers. The image style applies to images. Nothing applies to audio and video.
- Theme settings are copied into an output when it is generated. Changing the theme later does not change outputs that already exist.
- An administrator can distribute a read-only shared theme with **Provide to all users**.
- Of the built-in themes, the pickers show **Default** (기본) and **Document serif** (문서용 명조). **Presentation teal** (발표용 청록) is hidden from them; agents and outputs that already wear it keep it.

title: Web search and tools
text:
Choose **Web search** from the **+** button in the composer and set it to **Auto**, **Always** or **Off**. Auto is the default; Always or Off shows as a chip in the composer. The setting applies to that request only, and it resets to **Auto** in a new conversation.

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| Auto | Searches when you ask about information that changes over time, such as news, prices, schedules, latest versions, and weather. Otherwise it searches only when the model judges it necessary. |
| Always | Always performs a search for that request. |
| Off | Does not search unless you ask explicitly, with wording such as "search for" or "look it up". |

When a search runs, the answer shows numbers in the form `[n]` and a source list. One request performs at most three searches and reads at most six pages. Weather uses a dedicated tool instead of search. If you select a strict-local model, web search cannot be chosen.

Requests about current information need a search. "Exchange rate trends this quarter" and "Changes in Python 3.14" are examples. Calculation, translation, summarizing an attached text, and fixing code do not need a search. Setting the mode to **Off** for those makes the answer faster and avoids unnecessary sources.

title: Web search and tools
heading: Tools the model uses
text:
Models that support tool calling, marked 🔧 in the list, use the following tools as the request requires. Their use appears in the processing steps.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| Web search · Page reading · Weather | Runs searches and reads the body text of the pages it needs. |
| Code execution | Performs calculations, table processing, and chart generation with real code. This path is accurate for arithmetic on large numbers. |
| Arithmetic check | Calculates arithmetic and powers exactly on the server, and compares the result with answer choices or a submitted answer. It needs no extra server, and requests that call for a calculation use it first. |
| Find in files | Searches inside attached files and agent material. |
| Artifacts · Chart creation | Produces the result as a document or a chart in the right panel. |
| Shared notes | Leaves a note for other conversations in the same project to reference. |
| Connectors | External tools that you installed. Connectors |

Where the administrator has not connected a search server or a code execution server, those tools are not available.

title: Frequently asked questions
text:
This page lists causes and actions by symptom. To look something up by the error message shown on the screen, see Limits and troubleshooting.

### I signed up but I cannot sign in
Your account is waiting for approval. The waiting screen switches over automatically once an administrator approves it. Use **Contact the administrator** on the waiting screen to get in touch.

### I typed in Chat but it switched to the report screen
A sentence that asks for a document, such as "Write a report" or "Make a slide deck", switches automatically to a new conversation on that screen. To continue in Chat, phrase the request around existing content, such as "Summarize this".

### It says the file I attached could not be read
The file is a scanned image with no text information, or an older Office format (.doc, .ppt, .xls). Attach it again as a PDF, Word, Hangul, Excel, or text file that contains text. Attaching files

### My next question does not refer to the file I attached
The attachment stays available throughout the same Chat conversation. Check whether the processing steps of the answer show "Attachment from an earlier turn". Other conversations and the report and slide screens do not carry earlier attachments over. If the file is long, only the parts related to your question are passed, so describe what you are looking for in detail.

### The answer does not match the facts
The model may have generated something it does not know. Set web search to **Always** or attach source material. If the answer shows no sources, it did not go through search. Model limitations

### The answer is too short
The product is designed to leave out introductions and repeated explanations. Add conditions to your request, such as "in detail" or "with examples", or describe the length you want under *

title: Glossary
text:
| Term | Meaning |
